canonical_definition: A benchmark consisting of 2100 logical puzzles derived from SAT formulas, presented in natural language, used to evaluate models' ability to perform search-based logical reasoning and produce valid reasoning traces.
papers: SATBench: Benchmarking LLMs' Logical Reasoning via Automated Puzzle Generation from SAT Formulas

relationships.evidence: We introduce SATBench, a benchmark for evaluating the logical reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) through logical puzzles derived from Boolean satisfiability (SAT) problems.
